scope: Preserved fifty single-state collateral-limit diagnostics. Independent of sleeve-band policy and historical path; no actual lending approval.

measurement.state: prefee target gross assets/debt from configured initial equity and primary leverage
measurement.price_shock: uniform instantaneous asset loss; debt unchanged
measurement.sales: proportional target sleeve mixture; no external cash
measurement.fees: baseline per-leg trade cost plus optional extra forced spread
measurement.cure: debt after sale costs <= safety fraction * new lending limit * remaining assets
measurement.timing: single state; no financing accrual, settlement or historical path

source.role: Preserved public implementation evidence; numerical losses/limits/buffer are researcher-imposed hypotheses, not extracted account offers.

interpretation.state: Prefee USD7m equity/1.25x target means USD8.75m assets and USD1.75m debt before shock. No entry fee/funding accrual/capital-flow sequence.
interpretation.limits: Effective hypothetical lending fraction changes independently of market losses. Not the voluntary leverage band, historical maintenance LTV or a security-specific approved haircut.
interpretation.cure: No top-up, proportional sales and ordinary costs plus extra forced spread. Ninety-percent utilization buffer is imposed. Zero lending fraction requires full debt repayment.
interpretation.failure: Cannot repay after liquidation retains negative equity/residual debt; no invented solvent cure or guaranteed worst-case bound.
interpretation.account: Preserved source is generic evidence at original retrieval date. Actual eligibility, cure deadlines, execution, settlement and rates require separate account evidence. This calculation grants no credit approval.
interpretation.main: The absolute primary/capped-relative historical comparison and all economic inputs remain unchanged. No modeled historical lender action or live trade.
